symptom: Garbled phonetics in some entries (owner's report)
mechanism: AHD writes its pronunciation key as Private Use characters in MinionNew spans that no Mac font draws; the core writes them as Unicode by a fixed table, the stress as a styled span (a b tag drew AHD's own box)

symptom: A speaker icon in a superscript position (owner's report)
mechanism: rule S5 wrapped an image already inside a sound link in a second link, which HTML un-nests into an extra raised speaker

symptom: PEU's examples in its plain lists sat with no gap between them (G16: 117 of 411 at 0 px, want 8)
repro: peu:discriminatory and offensive language taboo words and swear words
mechanism: the content before each example was the inline list item before it, measured by all its fragments: around its block example it also has empty fragments, which sit at the next block's top, so the gap read 0 whatever the margin and spacing by role gave up
